Hello Voaters, I created a website where you can upload any files you want. Uncensored, unmoderated and unmonitored.

I'm not complaining, but I think uploaders should be aware, that this is not for long-term storage.

It's pretty much the first thing you see when you scroll down. And 30 days is a pretty long time for being inactive. If a file hasn't been visited for 29 days, and a web scraper bot or a lost voater finds an old link post or something, it will be renewed for 30 days.

But I agree, it's an important detail.
So it auto-renews if someone views the links 30 days after?

When the image preview page isn't visited for 30 days, the file will be deleted from the server. I have a cron job script that runs a database query that deletes all entries that haven't been viewed for over 30 days, after that a PHP script will delete all files that are not present in the database.

Every time an image preview page gets requested the last view time gets updated to the current time, and the file won't be deleted for another 30 days.

Hope that clears up the confusion :). It's all there so my server won't be full of files that don't generate any traffic at all, and I think links that are posted to voat.co will rarely be deleted.
